invariants.rationale: A rollback operation should return rollback metadata, so result should not be null.
rollbackInstantTime acts as an identifier for the rollback and should be non-null.
commitInstant represents the instant to be rolled back and is required to identify the rollback target.
The method is declared to return HoodieRollbackMetadata, so result must be an instance of it.
context is passed to the rollback executor, and should be non-null for engine operations.
